items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: What about Sonny Swan? He said, what about Sonny Swan? Sonny, he can read.

ctx.x: He said, Big I, Louis Robinson, how about him? Did he have anything special? No, just play. Some of us kick about, yeah, we get piano players, we just kick about and say, play like a woman. Light. He's soft. That's the only thing we used to kick about, but he's playing. The King got really good, you know. He can read. What about Sonny Swan? He said, what about Sonny Swan? Sonny, he can read.
Did he have any special numbers? He called Sonny Piano Baker. Did he have any special numbers?
